02240e6.speaker: Rest
02240e6.line: You're the last person I expected to see.

0deae64.speaker: Beat
0deae64.line: ...I hate to ask, but what day is it?

081609e.speaker: Rest
081609e.line: ...happy birthday. Sorry this isn't much of a celebration.

091e2c2.speaker: Rest
091e2c2.line: You were gone for a bit.

011eb44.speaker: Beat
011eb44.line: How long was I out? It feels too early for it to be so dark.

0fc4e1e.speaker: Rest
0fc4e1e.line: What's the last thing you remember?

0b94932.speaker: Beat
0b94932.line: I have no idea what happened.

0bb0245.speaker: Rest
0bb0245.line: And we don't know because HARM's latest complete overreach is, effectively,

0934c2c.speaker: Rest
0934c2c.line: Total martial law enacted in the zone around where that building was.

029b806.speaker: Rest
029b806.line: And Quaver's at the center of all of it, and Treble and Clef are in there too.

08303de.speaker: Rest
08303de.line: Are you still an annoying cop-hating freak?

0a83f60.speaker: BeatsMomVoicemail
0a83f60.line: You feel like shit, but screw it. You've felt like shit.

0b26d8a.speaker: BeatsMomVoicemail
0b26d8a.line: You can push yourself for the sudden bursts,

0137261.speaker: BeatsMomVoicemail
0137261.line: You shadowbox the air to prove it to yourself.

0b0cc84.speaker: BeatsMomVoicemail
0b0cc84.line: You do everything big and loud and awesome because you're better than this,

0eb24c0.speaker: BeatsMomVoicemail
0eb24c0.line: The diagnosis isn't good. But you can beat this.

0cf44cf.speaker: BeatsMomVoicemail
0cf44cf.line: And everything is great, and you're ordering Chinese food and saying screw it, this is nothing,

0d0a79d.speaker: BeatsMomVoicemail
0d0a79d.line: and telling your friend she's silly to worry,

01beaff.speaker: BeatsMomVoicemail
01beaff.line: and that this will be nothing in a month and less than nothing in a year.

0695732.speaker: BeatsMomVoicemail
0695732.line: But you're stronger than the chemo.

00f7411.speaker: BeatsMomVoicemail
00f7411.line: It does hurt. It really hurts.

060cacb.speaker: BeatsMomVoicemail
060cacb.line: In some ways it's harder to tell if it hurts worse than the thing it's supposed to be fixing.

0729c45.speaker: BeatsMomVoicemail
0729c45.line: But you smile through it, even if the smile betrays a wince, because...

03de211.speaker: BeatsMomVoicemail
03de211.line: ...well, you know. I'm not gonna keep saying it.

096a920.speaker: BeatsMomVoicemail
096a920.line: You've been a defiant little bitch your whole life,

05ad867.speaker: BeatsMomVoicemail
05ad867.line: You know it for a fact as much as you know how the dirt would feel beneath the wet grass on your toes-

04ed239.speaker: BeatsMomVoicemail
04ed239.line: -without needing to take your shoes off to check.

07bcedc.speaker: BeatsMomVoicemail
07bcedc.line: But one day you get curious.

0039695.speaker: BeatsMomVoicemail
0039695.line: And the ground is colder than it should be, and the grass is dry as a bone,

0b722ff.speaker: BeatsMomVoicemail
0b722ff.line: And the bottom of your foot is bleeding, and it hurts a lot.

0022224.speaker: BeatsMomVoicemail
0022224.line: And you aren't even afraid to die.

038aa4d.speaker: BeatsMomVoicemail
038aa4d.line: You got over being afraid to die when you were told the diagnosis.

07444b1.speaker: BeatsMomVoicemail
07444b1.line: Suffering does, though. Suffering scares you a lot.

033a3d6.speaker: BeatsMomVoicemail
033a3d6.line: Suffering the way you keep feeling on the edges, the way you're getting a sense of it...

09cecf0.speaker: BeatsMomVoicemail
09cecf0.line: ...it's the scariest thing you can imagine, and it only gets worse.

0f8e063.speaker: BeatsMomVoicemail
0f8e063.line: There is so much pain in this world and-

07d38de.speaker: BeatsMomVoicemail
07d38de.line: Beating this means becoming a machine designed to feel that forever and ever for even just a chance at more,

0334ef3.speaker: BeatsMomVoicemail
0334ef3.line: And the more might just be more of this.

02ccbef.speaker: BeatsMomVoicemail
02ccbef.line: You need to do that every single day.

0dac03b.speaker: BeatsMomVoicemail
0dac03b.line: And you've always known it was going to be like this.

0a3f083.speaker: BeatsMomVoicemail
0a3f083.line: And you've got fight in you!

015f0af.speaker: BeatsMomVoicemail
015f0af.line: But maybe not that much fight.

0a63ff0.speaker: BeatsMomVoicemail
0a63ff0.line: The thing about cancer is that, if it goes long enough...

04221d0.speaker: BeatsMomVoicemail
04221d0.line: ...at some point the rallying just stops.

07e0736.speaker: BeatsMomVoicemail
07e0736.line: Once you realize you can't actually win,

026ba6f.speaker: BeatsMomVoicemail
026ba6f.line: Your only two choices are to lose slowly or lose now.

0ff3ab1.speaker: BeatsMomVoicemail
0ff3ab1.line: The "you" in this is me, of course.

0af1090.speaker: BeatsMomVoicemail
0af1090.line: I'm not sure how else to talk about this.

0e06e37.speaker: BeatsMomVoicemail
0e06e37.line: It's even harder to talk about than it is to feel it.

0f5e216.speaker: BeatsMomVoicemail
0f5e216.line: I just wish I had a few more years left.

0de7b30.speaker: BeatsMomVoicemail
0de7b30.line: I wish you had them with me.

03ca31f.speaker: Brianna
03ca31f.line: I don't want to come off... a way, but...

038229c.speaker: Brianna
038229c.line: Beat, they're sending mail to the old place, and-

02dc5d7.speaker: Brianna
02dc5d7.line: A lot of these look like collection notices.

0300252.speaker: Brianna
0300252.line: There is none. If you want my help-

05750ee.speaker: Brianna
05750ee.line: Have you found another job yet?

088fdba.speaker: Beat
088fdba.line: It's what I was doing before you walked in here.

0a94775.speaker: Brianna
0a94775.line: I don't mean this as an attack but...

0486027.speaker: Brianna
0486027.line: I feel like you have to be doing something wrong, then.

05ded2d.speaker: Brianna
05ded2d.line: Like, maybe I could take a look at your resume or your cover letter-

0cf36d0.speaker: Brianna
0cf36d0.line: What about the Guitar Center job I told you about? Did you do the interview?

019932b.speaker: GuitarCenterGuy
019932b.line: Do you actually play guitar? Play me a song.

00b84f0.speaker: GuitarCenterGuy
00b84f0.line: Sorry, do you know any good songs?

0c978d8.speaker: GuitarCenterGuy
0c978d8.line: Not ones in plastic instrument games, please.

0b577a5.speaker: Beat
0b577a5.line: Which is like disqualifying any song anyone actually knows from being a "good song."

0dda4de.speaker: Beat
0dda4de.line: And thats crazy, right? Tell me that's crazy.

0cec32c.speaker: Brianna
0cec32c.line: Sounds like that guy has his head up his ass.

00d6211.speaker: Beat
00d6211.line: His ass wasn't big enough for that. Tiny butt.

088cb84.speaker: Brianna
088cb84.line: ...I might be able to help you get a job as a medical receptionist.

0f3809c.speaker: Beat
0f3809c.line: Look, don't worry about it, just...

0bcd1b4.speaker: Brianna
0bcd1b4.line: I hate to think you're just rotting in there by yourself.

0f90def.speaker: Beat
0f90def.line: Is that what you think I'm doing??

04c1208.speaker: Brianna
04c1208.line: Come on, you know what I mean.

0adda8d.speaker: Beat
0adda8d.line: No, I want to hear you say it.

042df8e.speaker: Beat
042df8e.line: What do you think I spend my time doing all day?

0bf7395.speaker: Brianna
0bf7395.line: Do you want me to be nice or do you want me to be honest?

0affd9d.speaker: Beat
0affd9d.line: You don't get to say that.

0a87fbe.speaker: Brianna
0a87fbe.line: You keep saying you spend all the time you've got job searching-

0071026.speaker: Brianna
0071026.line: But the one job you've gotten in months?

0d5a2a5.speaker: Brianna
0d5a2a5.line: You got fired for can't not be late to shit.

0986288.speaker: Beat
0986288.line: I'm just focused on other things.

0ea684a.speaker: Brianna
0ea684a.line: What other things? There should be no other things!

05e733a.speaker: Beat
05e733a.line: The band! My music! It's getting somewhere?

0eb508a.speaker: Brianna
0eb508a.line: Is there any evidence of that? Have you made any money doing this?

04fe75b.speaker: Brianna
04fe75b.line: Beat, I just want what's best for you. You know that.

09cd117.speaker: Brianna
09cd117.line: Are you gonna let me in?

07f2a3d.speaker: Brianna
07f2a3d.line: It feels kind of childish to just-

0075a6f.speaker: Brianna
0075a6f.line: I'll come back later, I guess.

00ac8e0.speaker: Apoco
00ac8e0.line: We're so glad you showed up.

057c0f7.speaker: Apoco
057c0f7.line: We've been waiting for you for so, so, soooo long.

0e86e52.speaker: Poco
0e86e52.line: Why'd you keep us waiting, Beat?

0566e77.speaker: Apoco
0566e77.line: We've got so much to talk about.

0373ba5.speaker: Beat
0373ba5.line: Can't you two take anything seriously?

0c3ead0.speaker: Apoco
0c3ead0.line: Always as much as it deserves.

036139f.speaker: Beat
036139f.line: I heard you both quit HARM.

0371c2b.speaker: Apoco
0371c2b.line: Oh, don't come to us with the past.

0109cf7.speaker: Poco
0109cf7.line: We're on your side now, girlie!

034d278.speaker: Beat
034d278.line: Then work with me and let me-

02f611a.speaker: Poco
02f611a.line: But, of course, you're the boss.

092215e.speaker: Beat
092215e.line: You're not listening to me. I'm trying to help you-

0da128a.speaker: Apoco
0da128a.line: We're working on a great campaign for you.

05de656.speaker: Apoco
05de656.line: "...where music is illegal... and you do crimes."

038dcab.speaker: Poco
038dcab.line: So snappy, right? So snazzy. Gets the blood going.

0b2a102.speaker: Beat
0b2a102.line: But it doesn't really mean... anything.

0bee7d5.speaker: Beat
0bee7d5.line: Oh, come on. You don't actually believe that.

09c32c6.speaker: Beat
09c32c6.line: You're telling me you don't care about what you make?

0b29831.speaker: Apoco
0b29831.line: What, you're trying to dig deep down into the dark depths of our soul?

05c5745.speaker: Apoco
05c5745.line: I'm not sure you'll get anywhere with that, girlie.

00b047c.speaker: Beat
00b047c.line: Does she feel the same way?

0bb8a14.speaker: Poco
0bb8a14.line: We're two peas in a soup.

0891763.speaker: Apoco
0891763.line: Be specific when you ask a question.

0ce4ca8.speaker: Beat
0ce4ca8.line: Why do you do this shit, anyway?

0729cc6.speaker: Poco
0729cc6.line: Uh, because we're good at it?

010421d.speaker: Poco
010421d.line: It doesn't have to be more than that.

02c0cb3.speaker: Beat
02c0cb3.line: Oh, come on, are you guys really that simple?

0a036f0.speaker: Beat
0a036f0.line: I expected more from you guys.

05e89b3.speaker: Apoco
05e89b3.line: You have it the other way around.

0cf0fd9.speaker: Apoco
0cf0fd9.line: We're good enough we can do this on autopilot.

0eda51a.speaker: Apoco
0eda51a.line: Why give it more than it's worth?

04ffe09.speaker: Beat
04ffe09.line: God. I didn't expect you two to be so predictable.

0ea8756.speaker: Beat
0ea8756.line: "Oh, we don't have to put effort in. We just show up looking like this."

00560f4.speaker: Apoco
00560f4.line: ...we're light on our feet. We're flexible. And we're fast at-

0772bc9.speaker: Apoco
0772bc9.line: There's nothing to buy. It's what it is.

09ae964.speaker: Apoco
09ae964.line: We're what you see on the tin.

0e736f3.speaker: Apoco
0e736f3.line: I wouldn't expect you to understand.

063720d.speaker: Apoco
063720d.line: For us, it's just a job. We can take it or leave it.

029cdfb.speaker: Apoco
029cdfb.line: This isn't some deep-seated self expression.

073d705.speaker: Beat
073d705.line: You tell me you put nothing of yourself into that?

050fb26.speaker: BeatOffscreenLeft
050fb26.line: It doesn't feel great when you get it right?

0cd7a1e.speaker: PocoScreenRight
0cd7a1e.line: Well, I mean, yeah, we... I like doing a good job.

02521a2.speaker: Beat
02521a2.line: It doesn't hurt at all when you mess it up?

0f2c190.speaker: Beat
0f2c190.line: Never forget I beat you two.

02b1e29.speaker: ApocoKneel
02b1e29.line: Come on. Do you really think we thought about that at all?

0289a8d.speaker: PocoKneel
0289a8d.line: Of course it hurts! It... uh...

07274dc.speaker: PocoKneel
07274dc.line: Right, we don't let it get to us.

04fb08e.speaker: Beat
04fb08e.line: Why does it hurt at all, though? If you're so above it all.

0d3ec66.speaker: Beat
0d3ec66.line: If you didn't care about the thing you did.

09db217.speaker: Beat
09db217.line: Just admit you give a shit. What are you embarrassed about?

04282e0.speaker: Beat
04282e0.line: The shit I do is the shit I am.

0921842.speaker: Beat
0921842.line: And yeah, maybe it's not healthy just how much self-worth I attach to what I make.

0a7b114.speaker: Beat
0a7b114.line: But I'm a mature enough goddamn human being to admit-

0ea90d8.speaker: Beat
0ea90d8.line: I care when someone hates what I've made.

09ca5c9.speaker: Beat
09ca5c9.line: And I love it when they love it.

095045f.speaker: ApocoSide
095045f.line: You can't listen to this Poco. She's just-

0b13490.speaker: PocoSide
0b13490.line: She's what? What's she trying to do?

0854836.speaker: PocoSide
0854836.line: She's too... messy to be anything else than what she is.

05a837a.speaker: ApocoSide
05a837a.line: We don't do this for ourselves. That's not the point of the job.

08c7488.speaker: PocoSide
08c7488.line: ...the shine is a part of us.

0392278.speaker: Apoco
0392278.line: ...If that's true, then why has it gotten so hard, lately?

03a9886.speaker: Apoco
03a9886.line: Because this work has been fun.

0fd583c.speaker: Apoco
0fd583c.line: I know I'm not pretending that.

09ca9f3.speaker: Apoco
09ca9f3.line: I like working with you on this.

0f4b2c2.speaker: Poco
0f4b2c2.line: Of course I like working with you!

02fc917.speaker: Poco
02fc917.line: ...I wish I liked the thing we're doing, too.

00cb04b.speaker: Beat
00cb04b.line: I don't get why you ever worked with them.

03e19ba.speaker: Rest
03e19ba.line: You have to trust people, Beat.

0343053.speaker: Rest
0343053.line: At the end of the day, that's all we are.

0666ed2.speaker: Rest
0666ed2.line: I mean, sure, some people shouldn't be.

08e6832.speaker: Rest
08e6832.line: But you can't come at life assuming that's who you're running into.

0f28977.speaker: Beat
0f28977.line: The best advice I've ever gotten is from the person I probably hate the most.

0f52767.speaker: Beat
0f52767.line: ...Or at least the person who probably hates me the most.

0e7dabb.speaker: Beat
0e7dabb.line: Shockingly, I knew people before that.

006488e.speaker: Rest
006488e.line: I hope he finds what he's looking for.

0acae32.speaker: Beat
0acae32.line: I don't even know if he knows what that is.

04b9760.speaker: Rest
04b9760.line: You know, it's funny. People think professional racing is boring.

047ccdf.speaker: Beat
047ccdf.line: Definitely didn't take you for a fan.

031aff8.speaker: Rest
031aff8.line: I'm a fan of useful comparisons.

0233ff6.speaker: Rest
0233ff6.line: People think it's boring because it's mostly the same thing over and over again.

051c987.speaker: Beat
051c987.line: A series of left turns, right.

09d544a.speaker: Rest
09d544a.line: Right. But everyone forgets how hard it is to do the same thing over and over again.

0c11c85.speaker: Rest
0c11c85.line: In those conditions, not doing the same thing even once can literally kill you.

0f82b54.speaker: Beat
0f82b54.line: So your point is consistency is hard.

0c16f83.speaker: Rest
0c16f83.line: If everything works right, most people are bored.

0614862.speaker: Rest
0614862.line: My point is that most people only find it exciting if something goes wrong.

0e63600.speaker: Rest
0e63600.line: Even if it's the hardest thing in the world to keep it right.

0c4b979.speaker: Rest
0c4b979.line: HARM's always been impossible to keep right.

0154108.speaker: Beat
0154108.line: Oh come on. You don't get that one.

0ba24ba.speaker: Beat
0ba24ba.line: You facilitated a borderline fascist police state.

0566ff9.speaker: Beat
0566ff9.line: I feel like that revokes any getting-to-say-you-did-your-best rights.

047042d.speaker: Rest
047042d.line: They were fascists before I got there.

0b6fc43.speaker: Rest
0b6fc43.line: Alright, fine. I am doing my best now.

0c0694c.speaker: Rest
0c0694c.line: God, I really did sound like you, once.

0cd0c5c.speaker: Beat
0cd0c5c.line: Okay, well, look. The day only just started.

07430f9.speaker: Beat
07430f9.line: Maybe a car will veer onto the sidewalk and non-fatally injure me.

0e0c530.speaker: Rest
0e0c530.line: We can't think about if she isn't.

0752d63.speaker: Rest
0752d63.line: Eve used to have this stupid goddamn thing she said all the time.

0d93d82.speaker: Rest
0d93d82.line: Quaver never even got the chance to see her mom screw up once.

0e3e5a4.speaker: Rest
0e3e5a4.line: And because of that her whole life has been spent aching for a mother so perfect she never existed.

002f4a3.speaker: Rest
002f4a3.line: It's... I hate how mad I am about it.

003dfc4.speaker: Rest
003dfc4.line: I'm gripping too many things and I've been doing it for so, so long.

0aeeed6.speaker: Beat
0aeeed6.line: It makes way more sense knowing this is your house.

08eee1e.speaker: Beat
08eee1e.line: It's... just... the overall vibe of the place.

056af85.speaker: Beat
056af85.line: Why do you still wear that uniform?

0ac233e.speaker: Rest
0ac233e.line: I don't really have anything else...

02c372b.speaker: Rest
02c372b.line: I need one thing, and then we can go.

03a6e05.speaker: Beat
03a6e05.line: ...a thought I'm obsessed with is that it takes seven years for your body to completely remake itself.

0a6a7a4.speaker: Beat
0a6a7a4.line: And the reason I can't stop thinking about it,

0ca97a1.speaker: Beat
0ca97a1.line: is that that the person I was seven years ago is gone.

0cd86f1.speaker: Beat
0cd86f1.line: And I'm terrified that I don't know who she is. That I've lost touch with that person.

036c457.speaker: Mirror
036c457.line: Maybe the kindest thing you can do for that version of you is to be better than they were.

02542e0.speaker: Mirror
02542e0.line: You just have to keep doing the best you can.

096aa5c.speaker: Mirror
096aa5c.line: And you'll get better at it.

0987a13.speaker: Mirror
0987a13.line: But you will get better at it.

0191580.speaker: Mirror
0191580.line: And I don't know who I am right now,

0fc19b2.speaker: Beat
0fc19b2.line: And I don't know who I am right now,

0dacbec.speaker: Mirror
0dacbec.line: But I am better than who I was before.

0aeb6d6.speaker: Beat
0aeb6d6.line: And I am seven years better.

0722aea.speaker: Beat
0722aea.line: I'm. Gonna be late for work.

0f27fbf.speaker: Manager
0f27fbf.line: You were already late when you called ahead. You need to be on the floor yesterday

011e3b7.speaker: Beat
011e3b7.line: I was here yesterday. You had me clopen!

0e0163d.speaker: Manager
0e0163d.line: You weren't on the schedule for yesterday, though.

04dd01e.speaker: Beat
04dd01e.line: ...Greg called me and asked if I could fill in since Ashley had a thing.

0624f2a.speaker: Manager
0624f2a.line: Well he didn't tell me that. What thing?

02b27ac.speaker: Manager
02b27ac.line: Why not? Regardless, this is my shift, and what happens on other shifts should not affect mine.

06ca882.speaker: Manager
06ca882.line: Which is why you need to be out there cleaning up your section before customers come in.

0136637.speaker: Beat
0136637.line: It's already clean. I did that yesterday.

0961c4e.speaker: Manager
0961c4e.line: Do you live in a zoo?

072e1e0.speaker: Rest
072e1e0.line: I'm not, but I can cook better than she did.

03c592e.speaker: Rest
03c592e.line: I miss her too, you know. A lot-

0907322.speaker: Quaver
0907322.line: You got to know her, though.

093afc0.speaker: Rest
093afc0.line: Just tell me what's going on.

0493db8.speaker: Rest
0493db8.line: I'm gonna need you to be specific.

04c101c.speaker: Rest
04c101c.line: You realize that's not my job anymore...

0ec5bb9.speaker: Beat
0ec5bb9.line: Wish I had clean clothes, though.

0d159cb.speaker: Beat
0d159cb.line: Let's try to get something going.

0d7313b.speaker: Beat
0d7313b.line: Why am I so shit right now?

0bbf6c7.speaker: Beat
0bbf6c7.line: And now I'm late, on top of it.

045a676.speaker: DC
045a676.line: You could have been a force for something that mattered.

0e9f9d3.speaker: DC
0e9f9d3.line: But you tied yourself to something useless and destructive.

0564ec1.speaker: Beat
0564ec1.line: Just stop being so stubborn and let me help you.

0bde256.speaker: DC
0bde256.line: How did you expect this to go?

0db9669.speaker: DC
0db9669.line: Did you think you'd corner me,

0fd1d65.speaker: DC
0fd1d65.line: And then a little tough love would get me to change my sorry ways?

0fa3c4a.speaker: DC
0fa3c4a.line: I'm not sorry about my ways.

079cd13.speaker: Beat
079cd13.line: We can change the rules. Sometimes rules are-

02c0371.speaker: DC
02c0371.line: The rules were fine as written.

0d4c0c8.speaker: DC
0d4c0c8.line: This place used to see something clearly that most don't even glimpse at.

05f26b8.speaker: DC
05f26b8.line: All of my years in law enforcement...

0aa4bf7.speaker: DC
0aa4bf7.line: I was at the Zero Moment. I saw the thing take form.

07cf8f1.speaker: DC
07cf8f1.line: It's everything I fight against and it's everything you are and you can't even see it.

029adce.speaker: DC
029adce.line: I reacted the same way I would now.

07a70f7.speaker: DC
07a70f7.line: They keep accommodating and accommodating and accommodating,

0077507.speaker: DC
0077507.line: And give more and more ground.

0f54dc2.speaker: DC
0f54dc2.line: Soon there will be no ground for us to stand on.

047bfb5.speaker: Beat
047bfb5.line: ...You actually believe in this shit, don't you?

05709e7.speaker: DC
05709e7.line: Crest already lost what we believed in.

08d6e10.speaker: DC
08d6e10.line: And the twins never believed anything.

0abd156.speaker: DC
0abd156.line: But I don't pay lip service to what I believe in.

05f28b4.speaker: Beat
05f28b4.line: That bow was your mom's, wasn't it?

034bd29.speaker: Beat
034bd29.line: ...you know, everyone, and I mean everyone, says it doesn't stop being hard.

0b4b12b.speaker: Beat
0b4b12b.line: But I wish that was actually true.

07fc9ca.speaker: Beat
07fc9ca.line: I would if I could, Quaver.

05cf90e.speaker: Beat
05cf90e.line: But I have to be here for both of us, and for, uh. Everyone else.

0407dbd.speaker: Quaver
0407dbd.line: It's not fair that that's getting shoved onto me.

0109835.speaker: Beat
0109835.line: For a long time I thought my mom was the only good thing in my life.

05ae8fd.speaker: Beat
05ae8fd.line: Without her, I had my sister and I had me. And I hated both of us.

0d88cd1.speaker: Beat
0d88cd1.line: I hated my sister because she tried to take care of me and she wasn't my mom.

05b7e4b.speaker: Beat
05b7e4b.line: And I hated me because my mom wasn't there to stop me.

059ce6c.speaker: Beat
059ce6c.line: And then that made it hard to do anything else. So I just... didn't.

0165ff1.speaker: Quaver
0165ff1.line: You don't... you don't have to do this. It's not helping.

00365dd.speaker: Beat
00365dd.line: You would do this for me.

0de25f5.speaker: Beat
0de25f5.line: ...I'm not good with these things. I'm not good at being a person.

04e207a.speaker: Beat
04e207a.line: I don't know how to make this better for you.

09fbf08.speaker: Beat
09fbf08.line: I just know what I've dealt with. And I know...

0e7516d.speaker: Beat
0e7516d.line: None of this is your fault. But this doesn't stop without you.

0de6d60.speaker: Beat
0de6d60.line: I need you to help me, here.

06bc5e1.speaker: Quaver
06bc5e1.line: I'd just screw it up. I've screwed up everything.

068baa5.speaker: Quaver
068baa5.line: And I don't care about whatever you're trying to do,

094cd63.speaker: Quaver
094cd63.line: And I don't care about anything else right now.

0063158.speaker: Quaver
0063158.line: I miss her, Beat. I keep missing her.

0f27b70.speaker: Quaver
0f27b70.line: And it hurts. I just want to forget how it feels.

0422591.speaker: Quaver
0422591.line: I used to be so good at just not thinking about it.

01d64da.speaker: Quaver
01d64da.line: I can't stop thinking about it!

0e9fd97.speaker: Quaver
0e9fd97.line: And I'm trying so hard to just feel nothing but it's impossible.

04d351e.speaker: Beat
04d351e.line: I was horrible to her, the last time we talked.

039e54f.speaker: Beat
039e54f.line: We fought over the stupidest thing.

0fcd4ad.speaker: Beat
0fcd4ad.line: ...The worst thing for me was the voicemails.

06df4c8.speaker: Beat
06df4c8.line: You hear them, and... and you're on the phone with her, again.

0be0ed7.speaker: Beat
0be0ed7.line: You're on the phone with her, but she's not on the phone with you.

0c34adb.speaker: Beat
0c34adb.line: And yet I still have this phone. It's almost twenty years old now.

028cccb.speaker: Beat
028cccb.line: But I don't want to get rid of it because if I get rid of it then I'll get rid of those.

0034785.speaker: Beat
0034785.line: ...but I do not want to live in a world where I don't have them anymore.

0c07b45.speaker: Beat
0c07b45.line: Some people just take up more space.

0dfddc5.speaker: Beat
0dfddc5.line: I always wanted to be one of those people.

025be64.speaker: Beat
025be64.line: I try really hard to be.

0400de6.speaker: Beat
0400de6.line: I carry a goddamn chip on my shoulder and I try to make that shoulder wider than it is.

0c5b9c7.speaker: Beat
0c5b9c7.line: But I don't think I fit in that box.

0d9dbac.speaker: Beat
0d9dbac.line: Or maybe I do and I'm just worried I don't.

0d68b35.speaker: Beat
0d68b35.line: Sometimes I'm worried I fit in there too easily...

0e00ac2.speaker: Beat
0e00ac2.line: My mom took up all the space in the world without even trying.

06aa080.speaker: Beat
06aa080.line: I don't know. I'm not equipped to think about that.

0cd666f.speaker: Beat
0cd666f.line: But it felt good to be around her.

0e0e9ae.speaker: Beat
0e0e9ae.line: And when she died, all of that space was suddenly filled with nothing.

07bcad2.speaker: Beat
07bcad2.line: And that's a lot of nothing.

054b7a5.speaker: Beat
054b7a5.line: It's heavy. And I can't grab it all.

0e61160.speaker: Beat
0e61160.line: I have too much trouble carrying my own life.

01958ba.speaker: Beat
01958ba.line: I have no space to carry death, too.

03c6991.speaker: Beat
03c6991.line: So I don't even think about her anymore.

090ab3f.speaker: Beat
090ab3f.line: I loved her more than I think I've been able to love anything or anyone since.

0e41b77.speaker: Beat
0e41b77.line: And I don't even think about her anymore.

0a81385.speaker: Beat
0a81385.line: And I don't want that to happen to you.

06d223f.speaker: Beat
06d223f.line: That's... that's what I'm trying to say. That's all I mean.

08f1543.speaker: Beat
08f1543.line: I think, sometimes, feeling hurt is better than feeling nothing.

05e0cd0.speaker: Beat
05e0cd0.line: It hurts to remember, but the remembering is the thing you've got.

0debd12.speaker: Beat
0debd12.line: Do you think she's right that we-

06327bf.speaker: Rest
06327bf.line: Does it change anything if she is?

0118447.speaker: Rest
0118447.line: If she's right, maybe we delay it a little longer.

0260b61.speaker: Rest
0260b61.line: If she's wrong, we get to prove her wrong.

01e7684.speaker: Beat
01e7684.line: Have you tried dating anyone new?

04a7de3.speaker: Rest
04a7de3.line: No. I hope you aren't asking because of her. I'd rather-

0de7c26.speaker: Beat
0de7c26.line: It's the way you were talking before.

0665d75.speaker: Beat
0665d75.line: I just ask because you seem a bit hung up on-

0cdef44.speaker: Rest
0cdef44.line: The last crush I had died in front of my eyes after never reciprocating my feelings.

0b1a497.speaker: Rest
0b1a497.line: I'm trying to be focused on other things now.

0d18128.speaker: Beat
0d18128.line: Take it from someone who is, right now, basically only focused on "other things:"

0cf1409.speaker: Beat
0cf1409.line: One day, you will be dead.

0e49144.speaker: Beat
0e49144.line: Right now, you are not dead. So, uh-

02b0665.speaker: Rest
02b0665.line: She once told me she thinks we look alike.

0670cee.speaker: Rest
0670cee.line: Me neither. But she sure does.

04113d6.speaker: Rest
04113d6.line: Said we "could have been sisters in another universe."

032bd60.speaker: Rest
032bd60.line: It doesn't matter, anyway. We might die before anything could happen.

00f88ee.speaker: Beat
00f88ee.line: Eh, can't win the lottery every day.

015c20e.speaker: Beat
015c20e.line: Literally never. Barely ever drink, too.

0376b88.speaker: Rest
0376b88.line: Really, never? Took you for such a rebel.

07eb3c3.speaker: Beat
07eb3c3.line: Bad for me, I have asthma, I need stronger stimulants, yadda yadda.

0d14343.speaker: Rest
0d14343.line: That's still a kid, to me.

0ac4024.speaker: Rest
0ac4024.line: Though when I was twenty-one I'd have said the same thing.

0115f30.speaker: Beat
0115f30.line: All those excuses are true, by the way.

0b7bcc8.speaker: Rest
0b7bcc8.line: Do you mind that I'm smo-

023875f.speaker: Beat
023875f.line: It's more awkward to ask you to stop.

039c6e4.speaker: Rest
039c6e4.line: Beat, it's hard not to think this was all my fault.

064f84a.speaker: Rest
064f84a.line: I don't think the Silence exist without me.

0208d98.speaker: Rest
0208d98.line: ...It's hard to talk about because I'm not even really sure about it,

062704e.speaker: Rest
062704e.line: But that first night, I was so afraid of that show.

0a4e683.speaker: Rest
0a4e683.line: That was supposed to be our last show, and I was terrified for weeks that I would never...

038215a.speaker: Rest
038215a.line: It's stupid. We were friends for years. But I thought,

0fc78f5.speaker: Rest
0fc78f5.line: I saw and I knew, deeply, in my core, that the things I was seeing were, somehow, the stuff I felt.

0befe72.speaker: Rest
0befe72.line: I couldn't explain this in words if I tried.

0c2e7d4.speaker: Beat
0c2e7d4.line: I think you know what I'll probably say to all of that.

0bdf8eb.speaker: Rest
0bdf8eb.line: What, that it's not my fault?

02e7315.speaker: Beat
02e7315.line: Did this use to be a cop car?

09683bb.speaker: Rest
09683bb.line: It started as not being one, then I had it retrofitted.

07503ab.speaker: Rest
07503ab.line: First color it was was yellow. I liked that.

0662f97.speaker: Beat
0662f97.line: ...pretty good? Come on, that was amazing!

03f9011.speaker: BeatsMom
03f9011.line: Alright, hey now. Let's not get cocky.

0600bbe.speaker: Brianna
0600bbe.line: I can't believe she actually said that.

0622a07.speaker: BeatsMom
0622a07.line: Look, now. You know I love you, right?

0d20c49.speaker: BeatsMom
0d20c49.line: Obviously. So do you want me to be nice or do you want me to be honest?

0ef80ba.speaker: BeatsMom
0ef80ba.line: I love, love, love that you're putting so much effort into this.

0e1b0a4.speaker: Beat
0e1b0a4.line: What did I do wrong? I was on key!

068b777.speaker: BeatsMom
068b777.line: You were! But singing the right notes isn't all of it. Tone isn't even all of it.

0e660ac.speaker: BeatsMom
0e660ac.line: It's a hard thing to figure out. It takes a lot of time.

0500e70.speaker: BeatsMom
0500e70.line: I used to be really, really bad at it.

06e9162.speaker: Brianna
06e9162.line: Oh, I definitely do. I've heard the tapes.

03acb3b.speaker: BeatsMom
03acb3b.line: We're circling back to that later.

05c64f1.speaker: BeatsMom
05c64f1.line: Look, how do I put this?

0118327.speaker: Beat
0118327.line: What the heck does that even mean?

07614ee.speaker: BeatsMom
07614ee.line: You're acting like you just want it to be over.

001f822.speaker: BeatsMom
001f822.line: You're trying really, really hard, but...

0d06cf2.speaker: BeatsMom
0d06cf2.line: You can't just sing the moments in the music.

02b3ad6.speaker: BeatsMom
02b3ad6.line: You have to let the moments sing for you.

079a407.speaker: BeatsMom
079a407.line: Beatrice, sweetheart, think of it this way.

08e5e08.speaker: BeatsMom
08e5e08.line: Say you're watching a movie. Like an action movie, right?

08481fd.speaker: BeatsMom
08481fd.line: There's this big moment at the end where the hero realizes he has something up his sleeve he forgot about.

0342b44.speaker: BeatsMom
0342b44.line: And the audience realizes it at the same time he does!

030d071.speaker: BeatsMom
030d071.line: Now, is it cool if he does it really fast after he tells us, or someone else tells us, what's going on,

08e514b.speaker: BeatsMom
08e514b.line: Or is it cooler if we sort of sit with him for a bit, and kind of figure it out along with him?

0453f05.speaker: BeatsMom
0453f05.line: Music is finding those moments, and letting them breathe.

0d76342.speaker: BeatsMom
0d76342.line: Mama's little baby makes me proud, okay?

02e9c7e.speaker: BeatsMom
02e9c7e.line: Yes you are, come here. Give me a hug.

0d42a1d.speaker: BeatsMom
0d42a1d.line: This...this is how singing should feel.

0c96a7b.speaker: BeatsMom
0c96a7b.line: Learn to love it like you love me.

0e0b32c.speaker: Beat
0e0b32c.line: Been a little upset lately, though.

04afda9.speaker: Beat
04afda9.line: Sorry, I'm being held up at work.

066aa55.speaker: Crest
066aa55.line: I haven't seen you in so long...

0aa2c1d.speaker: Crest
0aa2c1d.line: Beat, I've screwed up so many things.

04cc9bb.speaker: Beat
04cc9bb.line: Hey, dude, it's okay. It's just-

0f84ff5.speaker: Crest
0f84ff5.line: I've been really, really, really trying.

0158240.speaker: Crest
0158240.line: And nothing happens! It's all useless!

0797f7e.speaker: Beat
0797f7e.line: Hey, I'm sure it's not so-

01c5f75.speaker: Crest
01c5f75.line: It IS. It's so easy for you to sit there and act like everything's fine.

0141116.speaker: Crest
0141116.line: But it's not! It CAN'T be.

03d7286.speaker: Crest
03d7286.line: You know, I thought I could be a whistleblower.

0afd77c.speaker: Crest
0afd77c.line: I got this huge packet of all the material evidence I could get together.

0d0ce12.speaker: Crest
0d0ce12.line: It had everything I felt was off about what we were doing. And-

0475921.speaker: Crest
0475921.line: Beat, there isn't any news to whistleblow to.

01927b6.speaker: Crest
01927b6.line: All the media organizations from even two years ago have closed down.

0288bdf.speaker: Crest
0288bdf.line: Only the biggest ones are left.

02100bc.speaker: Crest
02100bc.line: So I tried one of those.

07238c0.speaker: Crest
07238c0.line: Do you know who answered the goddamn phone?

0ae6a1d.speaker: Crest
0ae6a1d.line: They were already running the editorial department of the place.

0d0f0b6.speaker: Crest
0d0f0b6.line: Poco and Apoco quit before I could.

07ba8be.speaker: Crest
07ba8be.line: And guess how they responded to all the shit I brought forward about HARM?

0b76275.speaker: Crest
0b76275.line: They were so excited to run the story!

05e0fd1.speaker: FloatingCrest
05e0fd1.line: No! No it's not! It's not good!

0875f60.speaker: FloatingCrest
0875f60.line: They wouldn't get excited about anything that matters!

09a3415.speaker: FloatingCrest
09a3415.line: And it made me realize that I was going to be stuck there forever.

0015dfc.speaker: FloatingCrest
0015dfc.line: I was never, ever going to-

0284ea4.speaker: FloatingCrest
0284ea4.line: I can't make people give a shit about me.

02965de.speaker: Crest
02965de.line: How can I make them give a shit about all of this!

08c48dd.speaker: Crest
08c48dd.line: And it made me realize that I was going to be stuck there forever.

032c1b9.speaker: Crest
032c1b9.line: Sforzando got locked up, and everyone's like "well, fine, that's taken care of."

02f1165.speaker: Crest
02f1165.line: But HARM is the same as it's always been.

01bb8c9.speaker: Beat
01bb8c9.line: Hey, it's okay! It's gonna be fine, it's-

00aa4ad.speaker: Crest
00aa4ad.line: ...why are you in here with me?

0437f22.speaker: Beat
0437f22.line: I don't actually know, but I want to help with-

0ee5d83.speaker: Crest
0ee5d83.line: You can't. You can't do anything.

06386e3.speaker: Crest
06386e3.line: I can't do anything. What makes you think you-

0950a76.speaker: Crest
0950a76.line: I just want to be alone! I can't let anyone else get dragged into this!

0e7a4e8.speaker: Crest
0e7a4e8.line: I keep screwing up what the right thing is.

0580229.speaker: Crest
0580229.line: I don't know what I should even DO anymore.

0016802.speaker: Crest
0016802.line: All I do is just make it worse!

05f5e6f.speaker: Crest
05f5e6f.line: You don't know what this FEELS like-

0a48fb3.speaker: Beat
0a48fb3.line: I don't need to know! I can see that it hurts!

0307e64.speaker: Crest
0307e64.line: Stop treating me like I'm...a baby.

02e835e.speaker: Beat
02e835e.line: I don't think you are but you need to stop acting like one.

052a61e.speaker: Beat
052a61e.line: You're acting. Like. A little. Bitch.

08e22df.speaker: Beat
08e22df.line: You're a grown goddamn adult man.

0df4b68.speaker: Beat
0df4b68.line: You're so upset with yourself that you were, what,

01b0179.speaker: Beat
01b0179.line: A mega evil supercop for however many years?

0eaf94f.speaker: Beat
0eaf94f.line: You really want to do the right thing?

0ea1650.speaker: Crest
0ea1650.line: I'm not going to be able to...

00cd316.speaker: Crest
00cd316.line: I can't do as much elsewhere.

09f5828.speaker: Crest
09f5828.line: I could do more being part of the thing!

0213264.speaker: Beat
0213264.line: There can't be. The tree is poison.

0c00c99.speaker: Beat
0c00c99.line: You have to not be an apple.

0d738a8.speaker: Beat
0d738a8.line: I mean. This metaphor is messy. This isn't a nature vs... thing,

0dfa8e3.speaker: Beat
0dfa8e3.line: or... you're not, like, inherently an apple, I guess, but... uh...

0d133ce.speaker: Crest
0d133ce.line: You remember how I used to think you were a maid?

02f5d36.speaker: Crest
02f5d36.line: The whole time. I haven't stopped thinking about you-

098cc12.speaker: Crest
098cc12.line: Uh, not like... not like that.

093f8ed.speaker: Beat
093f8ed.line: I actually didn't think you meant it like that-

084d62a.speaker: Crest
084d62a.line: I just... um. Well. My point is...

09d081a.speaker: Beat
09d081a.line: What, of the idea of being a maid?

0d6cdfa.speaker: Crest
0d6cdfa.line: I was jealous of someone getting to start from the beginning again.

0b7fe8f.speaker: Crest
0b7fe8f.line: Did you know I'm the youngest HARM officer ever promoted to be a Division Lead?

0d7ed4a.speaker: Beat
0d7ed4a.line: My dude, I don't know anything about your career.

0603aa3.speaker: Crest
0603aa3.line: Sure. I went from just some guy to being everywhere within fifteen hours.

0843b7a.speaker: Crest
0843b7a.line: This guy who was my senior officer when I was a rookie cop once told me...

0d6465a.speaker: Crest
0d6465a.line: ..."The most important thing about the police was 'location, location, location'".

07fe694.speaker: Crest
07fe694.line: What does that have to do with real estate?

04d925a.speaker: Beat
04d925a.line: Or maybe it was about making movies. I have no idea, I can't remember.

0dba109.speaker: Beat
0dba109.line: I think you're saying it wrong. It's meant to be a bit of a joke, I think.

0d30d80.speaker: Crest
0d30d80.line: He didn't make it sound like a joke.

06debd8.speaker: Beat
06debd8.line: Because you say it three times. It's, like.

0ce0ce7.speaker: Beat
0ce0ce7.line: And then it's just the one thing three times.

03e2c0a.speaker: Crest
03e2c0a.line: We kind of only have the one, anyway.

05945bc.speaker: Crest
05945bc.line: The one location. HARM isn't anywhere else in the world. Just here.

0b610bb.speaker: Crest
0b610bb.line: But since we're not gonna be able to go anywhere else anytime soon...

05d4f8f.speaker: Crest
05d4f8f.line: It's... it feel like an important responsibility.

0cd2285.speaker: Crest
0cd2285.line: ...well, at least he explained it as...

0f526ef.speaker: Crest
0f526ef.line: ..."Because you go from location to location to location."

05ec5a9.speaker: Crest
05ec5a9.line: The whole thing of being a cop, basically, is just you have to Be There, right?

0467f55.speaker: Crest
0467f55.line: At the places where things happen, so that you can make sure things don't happen.

087088b.speaker: Crest
087088b.line: I've been so, so scared of being anywhere else.

004336a.speaker: Crest
004336a.line: I've felt stuck where I am because I'm worried I can't do anything just being a normal guy.

04c33ad.speaker: Beat
04c33ad.line: No, you can. Do anything else.

0e8babc.speaker: Beat
0e8babc.line: Crest, I say this as nicely as I can.

0778f4d.speaker: Beat
0778f4d.line: Doing literally nothing at all is more productive than whatever you've been trying to do at HARM.

0ae3be9.speaker: Beat
0ae3be9.line: No. Even if just for your own sake, at least.

0c88a2d.speaker: Crest
0c88a2d.line: I just don't want anyone else to hurt anyone else.

0af9583.speaker: Beat
0af9583.line: You don't need to be a cop to do that.

001dce9.speaker: Brianna
001dce9.line: What do you mean you dropped out?

06502b3.speaker: Brianna
06502b3.line: That's for me to - I didn't ask you to do that!

08db2dc.speaker: Beat
08db2dc.line: It's not fair to you to keep paying for it.

0104bb2.speaker: Brianna
0104bb2.line: I decide what's fair for me or not! We could have-

0467901.speaker: Beat
0467901.line: ...It's not forever. I can go back.

018f7d5.speaker: Beat
018f7d5.line: As long as it's in a few years, I'll still have the credits.

09bd7ac.speaker: Beat
09bd7ac.line: Anyway, without enough money coming in I wouldn't be able to keep going regardless.

0844b17.speaker: Brianna
0844b17.line: We could have taken out loans.

0f702c9.speaker: Beat
0f702c9.line: First of all, no, we couldn't have.

07df05c.speaker: Beat
07df05c.line: And second of all, no, we really couldn't have, because we weren't eligible.

0c3e122.speaker: Brianna
0c3e122.line: There's always... you could have told me. You should have told me.

05509a9.speaker: Brianna
05509a9.line: We could have figured it out.

0bf6630.speaker: Brianna
0bf6630.line: I don't want to lose you, Beat.

0db3f04.speaker: Brianna
0db3f04.line: I- you know I get mad.

0ca4d65.speaker: Brianna
0ca4d65.line: I know you know I get mad.

0cd22aa.speaker: Brianna
0cd22aa.line: And I hate when I get mad at you.

01f9e70.speaker: Brianna
01f9e70.line: But I'm so scared, and you're so reckless, and it makes me feel crazy.

02b4ec1.speaker: Brianna
02b4ec1.line: Sometimes I get worried that you have some kind of god complex.

0f51280.speaker: Brianna
0f51280.line: You act like you can't die.

0a995a4.speaker: Brianna
0a995a4.line: But here you are, and you...

0728720.speaker: Brianna
0728720.line: You're not unbeatable, no matter how much I want you to be.

067ea68.speaker: Brianna
067ea68.line: The last thing we did before all of this was fight.

0f56366.speaker: Brianna
0f56366.line: And it was your fault, and I hate that.

00a931e.speaker: Brianna
00a931e.line: I really wish it wasn't your fault.

0eb9bcf.speaker: Brianna
0eb9bcf.line: Because then I'd be mad at myself and not you, and you're the one...

097fb4a.speaker: Brianna
097fb4a.line: I don't know if you can even hear anything I'm saying.

0f2b89d.speaker: Brianna
0f2b89d.line: But I say it because if I keep talking to you, you're still here.

044e7b7.speaker: Brianna
044e7b7.line: And if you're still here, I can get you back, maybe.

0a89249.speaker: Brianna
0a89249.line: And if I lose you, I'll never stop being mad.

039ad0b.speaker: Brianna
039ad0b.line: And I don't want that to be the last thing between us that-

080fe33.speaker: BeatsMom
080fe33.line: I'm sorry for scaring you. It's just-

0c7529d.speaker: Beat
0c7529d.line: ...is this really just another false alarm?

0190f4f.speaker: Brianna
0190f4f.line: But she's stable. That's a good thing.

0744025.speaker: BeatsMom
0744025.line: Tell me about how you're doing. How's the music going, honey?

0e0335a.speaker: BeatsMom
0e0335a.line: You were so excited about that band, and you haven't talked-

02839ac.speaker: BeatsMom
02839ac.line: Are you ever going to release that song I like? The one.

0b012e1.speaker: Beat
0b012e1.line: You know how it's going? The band kicked me out.

0388da9.speaker: Beat
0388da9.line: They kicked me out because they hate working with me.

0967ca0.speaker: Beat
0967ca0.line: They hate working with me because I can't make practice on time.

02d9847.speaker: Beat
02d9847.line: And I can't make practice on time because I have no time,

0a3a0c3.speaker: Beat
0a3a0c3.line: Because most of the time I'm stuck either being here or waiting to get called back here.

02c48cd.speaker: Beat
02c48cd.line: which you don't even care enough to know the name of,

078fc41.speaker: Beat
078fc41.line: I can't even listen to it now because of all this.

07c1af2.speaker: Beat
07c1af2.line: I'm getting abandoned left and right and not even my mom can be there for me.

0fc9e58.speaker: BeatsMom
0fc9e58.line: At least you won't have to deal with it that much longer.

09747f5.speaker: BeatsMom
09747f5.line: I'm sorry you feel that way.

0509a55.speaker: BeatsMom
0509a55.line: I wish it wasn't like this either.

0b63450.speaker: Beat
0b63450.line: Someone, please, give me a gun.

0bcc70d.speaker: Beat
0bcc70d.line: What's the worst that could happen?

038074f.speaker: Beat
038074f.line: ...I don't really want to be alive.

0122fc7.speaker: Beat
0122fc7.line: But I don't want to be alive.

0ad18a0.speaker: Beat
0ad18a0.line: It's a Christmas gift that wasn't on my list.

09303dc.speaker: Beat
09303dc.line: And I'm grateful, even, that it was given to me.

0d49c77.speaker: Beat
0d49c77.line: That I have time at all. But...

0ec08ad.speaker: Beat
0ec08ad.line: But I don't know what to do with it.

0600486.speaker: Beat
0600486.line: This might be the quietest my head has ever been in my entire life.

0a52b2b.speaker: Mirror
0a52b2b.line: Closest you can remember, at least.

0406923.speaker: Beat
0406923.line: The only time I've ever liked myself is when I'm on stage.

00c400d.speaker: Mirror
00c400d.line: That's not what the question was.

0511e0a.speaker: Beat
0511e0a.line: I don't know who this person is.

08d03a3.speaker: Beat
08d03a3.line: But there it was, with his voice,

0fa0ddf.speaker: Beat
0fa0ddf.line: and I just wished I was something at all.

088749f.speaker: Beat
088749f.line: Not even the best! Just something.

040d200.speaker: Beat
040d200.line: The same thing happened to my mom's songs, and then the same thing happened to my mom.

085255b.speaker: Beat
085255b.line: And it felt like I was just vanishing as the same thing happened to me.

0d099be.speaker: Mirror
0d099be.line: Is he the person you hate most?

01e7a24.speaker: Beat
01e7a24.line: No. I should hate him. I wish I did.

0c8d767.speaker: Beat
0c8d767.line: He gave me the best advice I've ever heard.

08ae45d.speaker: Beat
08ae45d.line: You make this sound so simple.

0260d2e.speaker: question
0260d2e.line: Ask yourself what hits the gut more and just say it like that.

0a8883f.speaker: question
0a8883f.line: You don't say to someone "I don't like you and what you stand for."

0e5509d.speaker: question
0e5509d.line: You tell them to eat shit.

021da97.speaker: Beat
021da97.line: I didn't forget any of it.

0a00c95.speaker: question
0a00c95.line: She's the only woman who puts up with you.

0aa7b0e.speaker: exclamation
0aa7b0e.line: She doesn't put up with me.

0c5bf3f.speaker: Beat
0c5bf3f.line: Just call me a bitch next time. It'd be more honest.

0f1dd37.speaker: Beat
0f1dd37.line: Christ. You're a ridiculous caricature of a human being.

06c5fb6.speaker: dot
06c5fb6.line: "You're a ridiculous caricature of a human being."

089d794.speaker: Beat
089d794.line: What did you even want to talk about?

0212b02.speaker: dot
0212b02.line: Yer out, shit-for-brain. We need someone in.

0464353.speaker: exclamation
0464353.line: I'll be polite. Look, you gotta understand.

0ab03ac.speaker: exclamation
0ab03ac.line: You dont have that much going for you.

0ef5426.speaker: exclamation
0ef5426.line: But you don't. You don't got it.

08da393.speaker: exclamation
08da393.line: We'll fix the songs you did stuff for to make them work without you.

0972d1f.speaker: Beat
0972d1f.line: Seriously? Not even you've got my back?

0ad5881.speaker: question
0ad5881.line: Some people just don't have it.

00e4165.speaker: Mirror
00e4165.line: They drive you out of spite, maybe.

0f09bf4.speaker: Beat
0f09bf4.line: I want to be on stage and in front of them, and I want to spit in their hair from a microphone.

0e06392.speaker: Beat
0e06392.line: I still want to make them sweat with the kind of jealousy that you get from not understanding why everyone else understands something.

0e28895.speaker: Beat
0e28895.line: It would be easy to say yes, but...

022aedd.speaker: Beat
022aedd.line: ...it's not why I think about these things.

0344ea0.speaker: Beat
0344ea0.line: If my dreams are unrealistic I want to change reality.

0289886.speaker: exclamation
0289886.line: God, I hope you don't think that's profound.

02d97d5.speaker: dot
02d97d5.line: "If my dreams are unrealistic I want to change reality."

0f007d4.speaker: Beat
0f007d4.line: I keep thinking about every time I could have made one fewer mistake or looked slightly cooler.

018c5a4.speaker: Beat
018c5a4.line: I wake up in a cold sweat thinking about those moments,

04962a5.speaker: Beat
04962a5.line: thinking that they don't think about me at all except to think about those moments.

094a290.speaker: Mirror
094a290.line: Does it hurt to think about your old friends like that?

0a7ac64.speaker: Beat
0a7ac64.line: I don't know if they ever were friends. They were coworkers.

09d2eb9.speaker: Beat
09d2eb9.line: Now I have new ones. And they haven't let me down.

0b93419.speaker: Beat
0b93419.line: Maybe not for a lack of trying

0e5a49f.speaker: Clef
0e5a49f.line: I'm so freaking serious I could shit blood, Beat.

0493d5c.speaker: Clef
0493d5c.line: I do not think you need a third chorus.

0509579.speaker: Clef
0509579.line: I don't think any song needs a third chorus.

07dd205.speaker: Clef
07dd205.line: Doing three choruses is like shooting a guy you just gave life-saving surgery to so you can give him surgery again.

0b28398.speaker: Clef
0b28398.line: Give it a solo or something, or a weird break, instead.

02b9fb2.speaker: Beat
02b9fb2.line: Even if I can't not think about-

0638d01.speaker: question
0638d01.line: Bee, you did great out there.

0308f0e.speaker: Mirror
0308f0e.line: But why do you do this?

073e8c2.speaker: Beat
073e8c2.line: I... I actually can't. I don't even know what I want.

0b51aef.speaker: Beat
0b51aef.line: Not because I haven't thought about it.

0ff8137.speaker: Beat
0ff8137.line: I don't even really understand what it is.

0d9a31d.speaker: Beat
0d9a31d.line: I only understand the space around it.

048ce04.speaker: Beat
048ce04.line: I can kind of see the shape the space around it forms, maybe.

086a17f.speaker: Beat
086a17f.line: I can almost tell you what it almost feels like.

052b874.speaker: Beat
052b874.line: There's this sudden small burning between my eyes like I'm going to cry,

03c8970.speaker: Beat
03c8970.line: It's in the space between my chin and my throat.

07883ce.speaker: Beat
07883ce.line: It's a lightness that reminds me of something I can't even remember I forgot.

0007eaf.speaker: Beat
0007eaf.line: It's all the things I've ever thought about.

0d3e812.speaker: Beat
0d3e812.line: It's just who I always have been, somehow.

0a43bd1.speaker: Beat
0a43bd1.line: And for those small quick flashes it's like I know what my soul looks like.

0aa38cd.speaker: Beat
0aa38cd.line: Like I can connect with the person I know I can be.

012ad6b.speaker: Beat
012ad6b.line: And my brain can suddenly understand something bigger than it can think about.

0850747.speaker: Beat
0850747.line: Bigger than the small container I live in.

08e0d46.speaker: Beat
08e0d46.line: And how do you...I'm trying...and I can't-

0c4c585.speaker: Beat
0c4c585.line: ...you can't just use direct language to say it because words aren't enough.

0f4ba4d.speaker: Beat
0f4ba4d.line: There's a shape around a space that you can't understand.

073551c.speaker: Beat
073551c.line: You can't even think at it right.

089e442.speaker: Beat
089e442.line: And there aren't words for that.

08e2fcf.speaker: Beat
08e2fcf.line: God, it's still beautiful, despite everything.

031f8c3.speaker: Beat
031f8c3.line: ...even if it emphasizes how truly awful this room looks in comparison.

000ab5f.speaker: Sforzando
000ab5f.line: You would think you would give your co-founder a warmer greeting.

02775bd.speaker: Sforzando
02775bd.line: Though I guess neither of us work there anymore.

0fa2123.speaker: Rest
0fa2123.line: What do you have to do with what's-

03c4da8.speaker: Sforzando
03c4da8.line: Wait, do you think I did this? You're not that...

054af5a.speaker: Sforzando
054af5a.line: You got me, wow, go you, geniuses.

043f14a.speaker: Sforzando
043f14a.line: Yeah, all of this? That's not me.

0c353ec.speaker: Sforzando
0c353ec.line: No, I can see the hamster wheels that rolled you here.

08ae4c1.speaker: Sforzando
08ae4c1.line: I actually designed a failsafe to do the thing you're probably thinking.

0c78c67.speaker: Sforzando
0c78c67.line: But I never implemented it because that would be stupid.

0547747.speaker: Rest
0547747.line: You think this is going to kill everyone?

0ce9558.speaker: Sforzando
0ce9558.line: The world has always been shaped by our perception.

03a623c.speaker: Sforzando
03a623c.line: Imagine if there weren't any years?

0848ff1.speaker: Sforzando
0848ff1.line: If we just noted the passage of time by saying it's "day one trillion and one?"

0675c6d.speaker: Beat
0675c6d.line: You've sort of explained this before.

0892975.speaker: Sforzando
0892975.line: Right. And I explained the thing you are.

08bbb08.speaker: Sforzando
08bbb08.line: I need to tell you that again so I can get to this.

0d58e83.speaker: Sforzando
0d58e83.line: Normally, Silence are basically a shape that feels like what you feel they should be shaped like.

08722ce.speaker: Sforzando
08722ce.line: Again, they're holes in the world.

04acaf9.speaker: Sforzando
04acaf9.line: The space is filled by you, and it's filled with whatever you're feeling.

08d555d.speaker: Rest
08d555d.line: So they can be whatever you want.

08b77af.speaker: Sforzando
08b77af.line: Whatever you feel. It's not about... want, really.

042eef1.speaker: Sforzando
042eef1.line: Want all you, well, want, it'll do nothing.

078bc18.speaker: Sforzando
078bc18.line: You can want them to be a breakfast buffet, they ain't gonna be pancakes, buddy.

0086460.speaker: Sforzando
0086460.line: But if you're really, really hungry, maybe they'll be a burger.

053da44.speaker: Sforzando
053da44.line: It's feeling. Which you can't control the same way.

0e67583.speaker: Sforzando
0e67583.line: Like I guess if you truly want something, like really do, and do it hard enough, but-

09dbba6.speaker: Sforzando
09dbba6.line: ...Whatever, completely not important and anyway it's besides the point, which is that music is-

0d88afe.speaker: Rest
0d88afe.line: It's an amplifier. It makes you feel things harder than anything else.

06b7bd7.speaker: Sforzando
06b7bd7.line: Music doesn't make us feel things.

0a258f7.speaker: Sforzando
0a258f7.line: And these things? They aren't filled in. They are just...

0a77683.speaker: Sforzando
0a77683.line: Same as the thing at the zero moment.

093801b.speaker: Sforzando
093801b.line: Anyway, whatever caused this isn't me.

0594908.speaker: Sforzando
0594908.line: Honestly, even if I didn't, that wouldn't happen. There's something else.

0897d83.speaker: Sforzando
0897d83.line: If I had to make a guess, it would be you, Beat, but you seem...

0759131.speaker: Sforzando
0759131.line: This literally shouldn't be a thing that could happen.

0f0b284.speaker: Sforzando
0f0b284.line: No feeling to latch on to means nothing to represent,

0d4f13b.speaker: Sforzando
0d4f13b.line: Which means that the nothing itself shouldn't be able to just be Nothing.

0833bbb.speaker: Sforzando
0833bbb.line: But the nothing has become something, and that something is Nothing.

0cd8c8b.speaker: Sforzando
0cd8c8b.line: ...look, I mean, you see the logic problem here.

0d8b319.speaker: Sforzando
0d8b319.line: ...So I'll answer your first question with: you can't.

0c8fa5c.speaker: Sforzando
0c8fa5c.line: There's not enough shit in the world to put in the space you need to fill.

01228a9.speaker: Sforzando
01228a9.line: I dedicated my life to trying to squeeze as much energy out of it as possible and...

0bf2806.speaker: Sforzando
0bf2806.line: I don't think I could come up with a way to fix the problem.

016289b.speaker: Sforzando
016289b.line: Can't pave over a black hole.

0a1c78e.speaker: Sforzando
0a1c78e.line: You want a magic bullet? Another answer?

0692608.speaker: Beat
0692608.line: That's the last thing I'd expect from you.

0f6be07.speaker: Sforzando
0f6be07.line: Good, because it's not going to happen.

0e236f9.speaker: Sforzando
0e236f9.line: Beat, we're in a pocket dimension made of my head.

0c5ac1f.speaker: Sforzando
0c5ac1f.line: If I felt any regrets at all I think this would look very different.

0bfe5e9.speaker: Sforzando
0bfe5e9.line: But I have a feeling you already knew that.

010a356.speaker: Beat
010a356.line: ...Once upon a time you told me I was trapped in a box. I-

04227e4.speaker: Sforzando
04227e4.line: What, you want to tell me that I actually was the one trapped the whole time?

00b480d.speaker: Beat
00b480d.line: We were both trapped. We still are.

0340c54.speaker: Beat
0340c54.line: I'm at least trying to find a way out, though.

0b9716e.speaker: Sforzando
0b9716e.line: ...Hey, if you do fix the end of days, tell them I helped.

0764dfd.speaker: Beat
0764dfd.line: You've been quiet for a while.

069516c.speaker: Rest
069516c.line: ...I wish he could be more than that.

0b8e647.speaker: Rest
0b8e647.line: How the hell did it get like this?

02c17de.speaker: Beat
02c17de.line: The situation with HARM was always going to go bad.

02c07e9.speaker: Rest
02c07e9.line: ...I keep thinking about the things I never said to her.

0c1f7bb.speaker: Rest
0c1f7bb.line: The sleeping in a bed together because the room had just the one...

01abc3e.speaker: Beat
01abc3e.line: Hey, are you... really, you and Quaver's mom?

05058b3.speaker: Rest
05058b3.line: I try not to let the pain get wasted. We're here.
